## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

## Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Flashback arrestors are to be fittcd on both tlic oxygen and fuel gas hoses near to the rcgulators and for long lengths of hoseflashback arrestors aretobefittedonboth the torch and theregulator.
- Fume extraction equipment or the use of a filtered respirator is to be used where there is a risk from welding fumes.
- A Gas torches are to be ignited by friction lighters or other similar devices only.
- When arc welding, welders must wear suitable eye protection that protects against intense ultraviolet and infrared rays. In addition, personnel working in close proximity must be protected from arc radiationby theuse of screens,shields or similar.
- Electrode holdersareto have afullyinsulated handlefittedwitha shieldorbarriertopreventcontact with the electrode or live parts of the holder. Electrode holders are to be unplugged when not in use.
- Welding leads are to be insulated, kept in good condition and protected from damagc.
- A Welding equipment is to be inspected before use and every 3 months by a competent person.
- A A"hot works'permit is tobe issued for all cutting and welding operations.

## 3.6. Electricity

- All permanent and temporary electrical installations are to be designed,installed,modified,
- Any electrical systems, circuits, installations, equipment is to be safe for its intended purpose and suitably inspected,tested and color coded before it is put into service and thereafter every 3 months by a competent electrical person.
- Users of electrical equipment are to inspect them before use and where a fault or damage is found the equipment is not to be used but tagged and removed from service.
- All electrical equipment including portable equipment and installations should be maintained so as to prevent danger.
- Electrical hand tools and equipment are:
- ·Tobedoubleinsulatedwhere220volt toolsareused
- To have a sound casingwith no loose or exposed cables
- To have an industrial type plug
- To be in good condition and subjected to a preventative maintenance schedule
- Electricalequipment shall be suitableforitsworkingenvironment.Only intrinsically safe equipment is to be used in workplaces where there is a risk from explosion or ignition. Electrical risk are to be reduced by using air, hydraulic battery operated tools whenever reasonable practicable.
- Electrical circuits and equipment are to be suitably earthed when operational. Temporary electrical equipment such as generators, weldmg units and lighting towers must also have earth protection.
